messages:
Alex: Quick async standup — overnight spike in cache-miss alerts in us-west-2 (02:30–03:10 UTC). SLO noise increased ~4% (p50 jitter). What I did: dug through traces, correlated with the embed-regenerator cron; lots of cold-prefix churn hitting the same embed bucket. Rolled a small throttle on the regenerator to smooth load.

Maria: Thanks Alex. Can you drop the dashboard links? Any chance this ties to the model swap yesterday?

Alex: Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/slo/cache-miss — most traces point to inference-app-v2. Model swap looks unrelated (traffic split unchanged), timing aligns with the regenerator job.

Chen: Oncall here — saw the alert flood and was paged at ~02:45. Runbook doesn't mention regenerator storms. I stalled the escalations but we should add a short playbook. Suggestion: add an automated prefetch step to the warming job and a cooldown window.

Sam: I can run a canary for prefetch replica bump today. Proposed window 12:00–13:00 UTC. Will coordinate with infra to increase warmers and watch SLOs.

Alex: Blockers: need sign-off on the canary window and a rollback threshold. I propose rollback if we see >3% error-rate delta or p95 latency regression >200ms. Ping @Maria and @Chen for sign-off.

Maria: +1 for 12:00 UTC window. Rollback thresholds sound good. Also recommend we tweak alert sensitivity so we don't get paged for short transient spikes — maybe require 3 buckets in 5m.

Chen: I will update the runbook after the canary is scheduled. Quick smoke test commands for warmers:

```bash
kubectl exec -n inference deploy/warmers -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health | jq .
# or
curl -X POST https://redwood.internal/ops/prefetch/run -d '{"prefix":"test"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_KEY"
```

DeployBot: deploy redwood/ops:warmers-canary @ 2026-03-17T11:58Z — canary rollout started :rocket:

oncall-bot: alert-summary — 120 alerts suppressed, peak error-rate 1.8% (02:40–02:55 UTC), SLO drift +3.9% temporary.

Sam: I'll run the load test during the canary and post results here. Ping me when warmers are up. :eyes:

Alex: Action items: 1) Sam — run canary + load test 2) Chen — update runbook with symptoms and rollback steps 3) Maria — adjust alert sensitivity 4) Alex — add perf dashboards & links to runbook. I'll write a short postmortem if the canary causes notable SLO changes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
